අති විශෙˤෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICE LONG SERVICE MEDAL AND CLASP
IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the President has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Sevices Long Service Medal & Clasp to the persons specified in the schedule here to.
Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha(Retd.) WWV, RWP, RSP, USP, fndu (China), psc Secretary, Ministry of Defence.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
